title: Historical wheel result through the workspace
summary: Exact retained failed native run, saved outputs and file tabs; no active vendor panel or process replay.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: History
manualSteps.instruction: Open its saved workflow link with printDemoRun identifying the retained failed run.

manualSteps.label: Return
manualSteps.instruction: Click Back to workflow, then View saved result.

manualSteps.label: Saved record
manualSteps.instruction: Click Open saved run record and inspect its workspace file tab.
